{"people":[{"name":"Tom","role":"Account executive (rep)","side":"us"},{"name":"PMM","role":"Product marketer (interviewer)","side":"us"},{"name":"(unnamed)","role":"Our solutions engineer, attended store ops workshop","side":"us"},{"name":"Angela","role":"COO; her team asked for the stores workshop; signed with Adyen","side":"customer"},{"name":"Raj","role":"CTO; ran the RFP; rep's main contact","side":"customer"},{"name":"Bev","role":"Head of store operations","side":"customer"},{"name":"(unnamed)","role":"Ecommerce lead","side":"customer"},{"name":"(unnamed)","role":"Adyen retail team, people who'd done store rollouts","side":"competitor"}],
"competitors":["Adyen"],
"incumbent":"Not named. The transcript mentions only 'the old tills', with store and web on two different customer records.",
"evidence":[
{"id":"E1","turn":2,"excerpt":"Buy online, return in store. The store couldn't see the online order","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Core trigger: cross-channel returns failed at the store."},
{"id":"E2","turn":2,"excerpt":"staff were refunding to gift cards or telling people to mail it back","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Concrete store-level pain from the returns failure."},
{"id":"E3","turn":2,"excerpt":"they'd just launched a loyalty program that was supposed to work everywhere and didn't, because store and web were two different customer records","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Second trigger: split customer records broke loyalty."},
{"id":"E4","turn":2,"excerpt":"Their COO, Angela, apparently stood in a store on December 27th watching the returns queue. That's the story everybody there tells.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["trigger","decider"],"note":"Hearsay ('apparently'). Ties the trigger to Angela, the eventual signer."},
{"id":"E5","turn":4,"excerpt":"The CTO, Raj.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Rep's first answer on the decider. Later revised to Angela."},
{"id":"E6","turn":4,"excerpt":"He ran the RFP, he was my contact the whole way.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"The only basis offered for naming Raj: proximity, not decision authority."},
{"id":"E7","turn":6,"excerpt":"This is secondhand. Raj told me afterwards.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Competitor information is relayed by the customer; the rep was not present."},
{"id":"E8","turn":6,"excerpt":"they came in with a retail team, people who'd done store rollouts","label":"fact","speaker":"Raj (via rep)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Adyen brought store-rollout experience, which we lacked (E20)."},
{"id":"E9","turn":6,"excerpt":"they talked about one platform for the tills and the website, on one contract","label":"fact","speaker":"Raj (via rep)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["competitor","language"],"note":"Adyen's pitch mirrored the customer's own words (E35)."},
{"id":"E10","turn":6,"excerpt":"And they named retailers Angela knew.","label":"fact","speaker":"Raj (via rep)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["competitor","gaps"],"note":"Adyen offered peer references. We could not provide a callable reference (E32)."},
{"id":"E11","turn":8,"excerpt":"Before, it was all web. Conversion, checkout, wallets. After, it was stores.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor","decided"],"note":"The customer's questions shifted from web to stores after meeting Adyen."},
{"id":"E12","turn":8,"excerpt":"What happens when the store wifi drops. How do you roll out 120 stores. Who shows up when a till goes down on a Saturday.","label":"fact","speaker":"customer (via rep)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["competitor","gaps"],"note":"Specific operational store concerns. 120 stores in scope."},
{"id":"E13","turn":8,"excerpt":"Raj forwarded me a list of 14 questions and 11 of them were about stores.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor","decided"],"note":"Documented: 11 of 14 questions were store-focused."},
{"id":"E14","turn":10,"excerpt":"Reaction: the online checkout demo. Their ecommerce lead loved it.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Web demo landed, but with the ecommerce lead, not the decider."},
{"id":"E15","turn":10,"excerpt":"Silence: the unified commerce part. I had the slide.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Our core positioning got no reaction."},
{"id":"E16","turn":10,"excerpt":"Online and in-store on one platform, the line between them has pretty much disappeared.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep (our slide)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language"],"note":"Our pitch claim, which we never demonstrated (E34)."},
{"id":"E17","turn":10,"excerpt":"that's a diagram.","label":"quote","speaker":"Bev, head of store operations","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"The customer dismissed our unified commerce slide as abstract."},
{"id":"E18","turn":10,"excerpt":"Then she asked how a return works. Step by step. At the till.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","gaps"],"note":"Bev wanted the concrete trigger scenario shown, not a diagram."},
{"id":"E19","turn":12,"excerpt":"I described it.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","gaps"],"note":"Vague answer. We described the return; we did not show it."},
{"id":"E20","turn":14,"excerpt":"They had six people from store operations. Nobody on our side had run a store rollout.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","gaps"],"note":"Six customer store ops people against two from us, with no rollout experience."},
{"id":"E21","turn":14,"excerpt":"When Bev asked who does the installs, I said we'd bring in a partner. She wrote something down and didn't ask another question.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","gaps"],"note":"Observed moment of disengagement. Partner answer clashes with 'two vendors' (E36)."},
{"id":"E22","turn":14,"excerpt":"I knew on the drive home.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","outcome"],"note":"The rep's own read of when the deal was lost."},
{"id":"E23","turn":14,"excerpt":"Right before that, honestly, we were ahead.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Rep believes we led before the stores workshop."},
{"id":"E24","turn":14,"excerpt":"Raj said so. We'd won the web side.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["decided","outcome"],"note":"Based on Raj, who was not the signer. 'Won the web side' is the rep's claim."},
{"id":"E25","turn":16,"excerpt":"Angela's team. Stores.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","decided"],"note":"The decisive workshop was requested by Angela's side."},
{"id":"E26","turn":18,"excerpt":"Angela.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","outcome"],"note":"Angela signed with Adyen."},
{"id":"E27","turn":20,"excerpt":"...Probably Angela.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Rep revises the decider from Raj to Angela."},
{"id":"E28","turn":20,"excerpt":"Raj wanted us. I think.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Our champion was not the decision maker."},
{"id":"E29","turn":20,"excerpt":"He told me he did.","label":"fact","speaker":"Raj (via rep)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Raj's stated support for us."},
{"id":"E30","turn":22,"excerpt":"Once. The kickoff.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","gaps"],"note":"Rep met the actual decider only once."},
{"id":"E31","turn":24,"excerpt":"A retailer they could call. We sent a case study.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"They asked for a reference call. We sent a document."},
{"id":"E32","turn":24,"excerpt":"can I talk to them?","label":"quote","speaker":"Angela, COO","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"The decider directly asked for a peer reference."},
{"id":"E33","turn":24,"excerpt":"we couldn't set up a call in time","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Reference gap. Adyen named retailers Angela knew (E10)."},
{"id":"E34","turn":24,"excerpt":"Then a rollout plan. Dates, who installs, what happens to the old tills.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"No rollout plan was provided. Reveals existing tills to be replaced."},
{"id":"E35","turn":24,"excerpt":"They wanted to watch an online order get returned at a store till, live. We described it. We never showed it.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","trigger"],"note":"We never demoed the exact trigger scenario."},
{"id":"E36","turn":26,"excerpt":"One system for the tills and the website.","label":"quote","speaker":"Bev, head of store operations","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"The customer's framing, repeated 'every time'."},
{"id":"E37","turn":26,"excerpt":"I don't want two vendors pointing at each other.","label":"quote","speaker":"Angela, COO","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","gaps"],"note":"The decider's concern. Conflicts with our partner-installs answer."},
{"id":"E38","turn":26,"excerpt":"one customer, one basket.","label":"quote","speaker":"Angela, COO","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","trigger"],"note":"Echoes the split-customer-record trigger (E3)."},
{"id":"E39","turn":26,"excerpt":"They never said \"unified commerce.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","message"],"note":"Our headline term was never in the customer's vocabulary."},
{"id":"E40","turn":26,"excerpt":"We kept saying \"in-person payments\" and \"point of sale.\" They said \"the tills.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Vocabulary mismatch on the store side."},
{"id":"E41","turn":28,"excerpt":"I think we had the better product online. I still think that.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome","message"],"note":"Rep anchors on web strength, while the deal turned on stores."}],
"contradictions":[
{"evidence":["E5","E26","E27"],"what":"The rep named Raj as the decider, then admitted Angela signed with Adyen and 'probably' made the call."},
{"evidence":["E5","E30"],"what":"The rep treated Raj as the key contact but met the actual decider, Angela, only once, at kickoff."},
{"evidence":["E23","E24","E22"],"what":"The rep says we were ahead, based on Raj, yet that belief came from the non-decider and collapsed at the stores workshop."},
{"evidence":["E16","E35","E17"],"what":"Our slide claims online and in-store are seamless on one platform, but we never showed an online order returned at a till."},
{"evidence":["E31","E32","E33"],"what":"We answered a request for a callable retailer with a case study; Angela explicitly asked to talk to them."},
{"evidence":["E21","E37"],"what":"The rep answered installs with 'bring in a partner' while the decider did not want two vendors."},
{"evidence":["E41","E13","E25"],"what":"The rep stresses the better online product, but the evaluation shifted to stores (11 of 14 questions)."}],
"dodges":[
{"question":"Who made the final call, and how do you know?","turn":4,"what":"Named Raj based on contact role only; did not say how he knew. Revised to Angela at T20."},
{"question":"What did you say?","turn":12,"what":"Answered 'I described it.' with no detail on how he responded to Bev's return question."},
{"question":"So who made the final call?","turn":20,"what":"Hedged: 'Probably Angela', then pivoted to Raj wanting us."},
{"question":"Anything else?","turn":28,"what":"Offered an opinion on our online product instead of new evidence."}],
"skipped":[],
"language_pairs":[
{"theirs":"the tills","ours":"in-person payments / point of sale","evidence":["E40"]},
{"theirs":"One system for the tills and the website.","ours":"unified commerce","evidence":["E36","E39","E15"]},
{"theirs":"one customer, one basket.","ours":"Online and in-store on one platform, the line between them has pretty much disappeared.","evidence":["E38","E16"]},
{"theirs":"I don't want two vendors pointing at each other.","ours":"we'd bring in a partner","evidence":["E37","E21"]}],
"outcome_signals":[
{"evidence":["E26"],"what":"Lost: Angela signed with Adyen."},
{"evidence":["E22","E21"],"what":"Rep sensed the loss after the stores workshop, when Bev disengaged."},
{"evidence":["E24","E14","E41"],"what":"The rep claims we 'won the web side', but nothing shows any business stayed with us. Partial outcome is unconfirmed."},
{"evidence":["E9"],"what":"Adyen pitched one platform for tills and website on one contract, suggesting the whole scope moved to Adyen."}]}

contradictions.what: The rep named Raj as the decider, then admitted Angela signed with Adyen and 'probably' made the call.
The rep treated Raj as the key contact but met the actual decider, Angela, only once, at kickoff.
The rep says we were ahead, based on Raj, yet that belief came from the non-decider and collapsed at the stores workshop.
Our slide claims online and in-store are seamless on one platform, but we never showed an online order returned at a till.
We answered a request for a callable retailer with a case study; Angela explicitly asked to talk to them.
The rep answered installs with 'bring in a partner' while the decider did not want two vendors.
The rep stresses the better online product, but the evaluation shifted to stores (11 of 14 questions).

dodges.question: Anything else?
dodges.what: Offered an opinion on our online product instead of new evidence.
